source_note: Impact uses 40% EPM, 40% DPM, and 20% skill model output. Skill dimensions use a current-season-first 4,000-minute stabilized window with 0.75 per-season prior decay, light draft priors for first-year players, and low-sample shrinkage. Replacement is a trailing 3-year position-count cutoff at the 65th rotation-useful player per position-season. Raw value live-casts current impact over blended expected minutes; Szn VA is season-produced value above available salary; FA value uses projected TIMIN, salary floors, max caps, market redistribution, and unmodeled roster reserves.
